meta.sources_note: Expansion batch 10 (DECISIONS 032, continuous expansion per DECISIONS 027, no per-batch approval): 5 new models, 15 quotes. Meta Catalog CLI run 2026-11-06 (20 rows per model; raw files data/meta_catalog_raw_{studio-display,linkbuds-fit,access-controller,pop-keys,elite-series-2-core}_2026-11-06.json, gitignored). Brand-direct / retailer prices verified read-only 2026-11-06 ~18:23-18:27 UTC (10:23-10:27 PT): no sign-in, no cart, no purchase. CORRECTIONS vs the 2026-10-31 candidate notes: (1) The current Studio Display is the March 2026 refresh (A19 chip, Thunderbolt 5, 12MP Center Stage camera with Desk View, 27-inch 5K 60Hz 600-nit panel, on sale 2026-03-11), NOT the 2022 model (A13, Thunderbolt 3, MK0U3LL/A, UPC 0194253030447) — the base price is coincidentally the same $1,599, and the pinned config is Standard glass, Tilt-adjustable stand, MFEX4LL/A, UPC 195950529173. The Studio Display XDR (mini-LED, 120Hz, from $3,299) is a separate line and was not added. (2) The LinkBuds Fit candidate price $229.99 is the list price; the current street price is $198.00-$199.99 (Best Buy $199.99, B&H $198.00, Crutchfield $198.00). (3) The Access Controller candidate price $89 is $89.00 direct / $89.99 list (PlayStation Direct $89.00, GameStop $89.99, Target $87.99); Best Buy's live $79.95 offer is sold by marketplace seller A2Z Games Inc and was excluded per DECISIONS 021. (4) The POP Keys candidate price $99.99 is confirmed current (Logitech direct $99.99 InStock; Dell $89.99 sale); the feed's Best Buy Blast Yellow $69.99 and Heartbreaker Rose $117.22 rows are different colorways. (5) The Elite Series 2 Core candidate range $111.74-$139.99 resolves to $111.74 at Microsoft Store (current sale price) and $149.99 retailer list (Best Buy, P.C. Richard, Kohl's, Lenovo); the $139.99 ShopCGX feed row is titled 'Series 2', not Core, and was not used. Two direct prices are price-only (stock not confirmed in the page text): Microsoft direct Elite Core $111.74 (JSON-LD price) and PlayStation Direct Access $89.00; the Best Buy LinkBuds Fit $199.99 is also price-only. B&H LinkBuds Fit is Special Order (expected availability 2-4 Weeks), not in stock. Excluded as captured: marketplace/third-party rows (DECISIONS 021) — Best Buy Access $79.95 (A2Z Games Inc), Target POP Keys Cosmos $111.22 (Mega Retail Store), NFM Elite Core White $106.99 sale (unverified), the $289.98 Elite Core dual-controller bundle; non-US rows — LinkBuds Fit NZ EAN 4548736157897, POP Keys AU Cosmos Lavender 920-011227 (GTIN 097855179340), Elite Core AU barcode 889842717082 / LV 889842717075, Studio Display UK MFEX4B/A GTIN 195950528992, Access UK EAN 711719567929; bundles — Elite Core dual-controller bundle ($289.98), LinkBuds Fit case/accessory combos, POP Keys + POP Mouse combo; different variants — Studio Display XDR (from $3,299), Studio Display MFEW4LL/A tilt-and-height ($1,999), MFEY4LL/A VESA ($1,599), MFF14LL/A nano tilt ($1,899), MFF04LL/A nano tilt-and-height ($2,299), MFF24LL/A nano VESA, the 2022 Studio Display MK0U3LL/A, LinkBuds Open ($228), LinkBuds Fit White/Sage Green/Pink/Violet, POP Keys Blast Yellow 920-010707 / Heartbreaker Rose 920-010709 / Mist 920-011232 / Daydream, POP Icon Keys ($49.99), POP Mouse rows, the full Elite Series 2 Black (FST-00001), the 2025 Elite Core colorways (Blue, Red and Blue, Green and Blue, Astral Purple, Gray, Dark Green).
